errors.text: The antiferromagnetic interaction is framed primarily as cross-phase coupling between the fcc matrix and a Ti-rich C14 phase, whereas the target mechanism concerns antiparallel coupling between Fe/Co/Ni and Ti sublattices and calculations identify ferromagnetic ground states for both phases.

The hypothesis assumes that the C14 phase remains antiferromagnetic or weakly ferromagnetic at 400 K, despite the phase-isolation results placing the C14-associated transitions near 246 K and 183 K; this makes its proposed direct magnetic role at 400 K unsupported.
